purpose: Teach: Ｗ杯/ワタ/笋/鬚/鵑/颪/蕕/紊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、Ｗ杯開催に伴う社会変動の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper explored social changes brought about by the World Cup, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, measured tone. Gentle confirmation, as if reviewing a familiar record. Even pacing, professional but approachable. The slight lift at the end is genuine interest, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、棉、つまりワタの繊維長の品種研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched cotton fiber length across different cultivars for my paper.
lines.style: Quick, precise correction. No defensiveness, just factual clarity. Slight forward momentum on the affirmation. He knows this matters to get right. Steady eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、笋、つまりタケノコの成長速度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined the growth rate of bamboo shoots, correct?
lines.style: Gentle restatement, as if offering him another chance to align the record. Slightly slower pace. Curious rather than challenging. A teacher giving space for truth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、軟体動物の鬚、つまり触手の進化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the evolution of tentacles in mollusks for my paper.
lines.style: Quiet, careful delivery. He's correcting again, but without frustration. The words come deliberately. A slight pause after 'Yes' shows he's aware of the pattern. Small, determined breath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、和歌の鵑、つまり杜鵑の象徴の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper investigated the symbolism of the cuckoo bird in classical poetry, didn't it?
lines.style: Still measured, but with a subtle shift—perhaps a trace of curiosity about where this is leading. Thoughtful pacing. The question lands gently but with weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、六甲颪、つまり地域風の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I studied regional wind patterns, specifically the Rokko wind, for my research.
lines.style: Steady correction, but now there's a faint undercurrent of weariness. He's still precise, but the rhythm shows he's noticing the pattern. No defensiveness, just quiet acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬草の蕕、つまり灌木の薬効研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered the medicinal properties of shrub species in herbal medicine, right?
lines.style: Same reflective tone, but now with gentler weight. Teacher-to-student, but also adult-to-young-adult. There's almost a kindness in the restatement, as if she sees what's happening and isn't judging it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦後の社会風紀の紊乱、つまり紊れの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched postwar social disorder and moral disruption in my paper.
lines.style: Final correction lands with quiet resolve. Slower, more deliberate. The word 'Yes' carries the weight of seven corrections absorbed without complaint. He closes on this one with finality—a small exhale of relief that the pattern is ending.
